decisions.reason: The burner component draws directly on the firm's core radiant-heater engineering and supports its gas infrared line, so it is cheap to keep even though it is barely visible on the website.

This flagship multi-model electric panel line extends the firm's established infrared knowledge toward electrification, and in-house R&D can keep refining it as the market moves toward electric heating.
The industrial electric hall heater line serves the firm's core large-hall market, where its experience and field-service network let it read early results and improve the product.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a documented real-world deployment, building on core gas-radiant expertise and matching the firm's low-carbon direction.
